Traffic Lights of New York (TLoNY)



	
		
	
	
		Traffic Lights of New York (TLoNY)
	

An object detection dataset for fine-grained classification of traffic lights in New York City. The dataset includes both vehicular and pedestrian traffic signals with detailed color state annotations.

	
		
	
	
		Overview
	


  



TLoNY provides accurately labeled traffic light data suitable for training object detection models, sourced from publicly available images from Unsplash. The dataset… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mehmetkeremturkcan/traffic-lights-of-new-york.
